issues.title: Support k8s_release in kubectl_configure
issues.body:
See https://github.com/bazelbuild/rules_k8s/pull/648

Also default to using k8s_release to avoid issues with github archives potentially changing

issues.title: Handle kubectl diff exit code when diffs are found
issues.body:
(merging into discord-main until it's upstreamed)

kubectl diff exits with code 1 if a diff is found. Because of the exit flag, this causes the bazel kubectl diff action to exit early. So this attempts to handle that without losing general script-level exit code handling.
